slides.title: US senators urge Rubio to act on Ethiopia
slides.body: Five Democrats sent a letter, per a Senate release.

slides.title: What they ask for
slides.body: Mediation with all parties, public aid assessments, and a pause on new arms sales.

slides.title: Assab and Americans
slides.body: They say forcible access to Assab is unacceptable, and urge TPS for eligible Ethiopians.

slides.title: No official response reported
slides.body: Senators' own account of their letter. Not independently verified.

slides.title: Protect civilians, back dialogue
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Source: US Senate Foreign Relations Committee Democrats (Nov 10) · letter's own account
